items.title: American Red Cross
items.summary: Disaster shelter providing food, mental health support, health services, and referrals for individuals impacted by natural or man-made disasters.

items.title: Be Ready CDC - Esther's Place
items.summary: Long-term transitional housing for women and their children on Wilmington's west side to support recovery and stability.

items.title: Be Ready CDC - Lazarus House
items.summary: Long-term transitional housing for men recently released from prison on Wilmington's west side.

items.title: Catholic Charities - Bayard House
items.summary: Residential program with housing, case management, healthcare access, and life skills support for at-risk, homeless, or pregnant and parenting teens.

items.title: Child Inc - Domestic Violence Shelters
items.summary: Confidential emergency shelter for domestic violence survivors. Includes safety planning, advocacy, and case management. Emergency hotel placement may be available.

items.title: Child Inc. - Runaway and Homeless Youth Program
items.summary: 24-hour hotline plus free counseling, temporary emergency shelter, and support services for runaway and homeless youth and their families.
items.organization: Child Inc. - Runaway and Homeless Youth Program

items.title: Delaware State Housing Authority - SRAP
items.summary: State-funded rental voucher program covering a portion of rent for eligible Delaware residents. Applications must go through a partnering agency.

items.title: Family Promise of Northern New Castle County
items.summary: Comprehensive homeless family support including temporary shelter, rapid rehousing, and intensive case management across multiple programs to help families achieve housing independence.
items.organization: Family Promise of Northern New Castle County

items.title: Friendship House
items.summary: Transitional housing combining subsidized housing with holistic programming for adults recovering from substance abuse, domestic violence, or incarceration. Multiple houses across Wilmington for men and women.

items.title: Habitat for Humanity
items.summary: Homeownership preparation and education program for income-eligible individuals, helping residents achieve homeownership through Habitat's program.

items.title: Hilda Davis Residence
items.summary: Permanent housing for low-income women experiencing homelessness who are employable. Operated by YWCA Delaware.

items.title: Housing Opportunities of Northern Delaware, Inc. (HOND)
items.summary: Fair housing advocacy, credit counseling, homebuyer education, and foreclosure prevention counseling for northern Delaware residents.
items.organization: Housing Opportunities of Northern Delaware, Inc. (HOND)

items.title: Limen Recovery and Wellness
items.summary: Sober living for adults recovering from drug or alcohol addiction using a 12-step recovery model.

items.title: Maria Lorenza Longo House
items.summary: Long-term housing for women who need ongoing support to avoid becoming homeless.

items.title: Ministry of Caring Inc
items.summary: Comprehensive nonprofit serving Wilmington's most vulnerable through meals, shelter, transitional housing, job assistance, dental care, early childhood education, and senior housing.

items.title: Mother Mary of Hope House II
items.summary: Emergency shelter for homeless women with children. Stays of 30–45 days with case management included.
items.organization: Mother Mary of Hope House II

items.title: Mother Mary of Hope House III
items.summary: Emergency shelter for homeless women with children. Stays of 30–45 days with case management included.
items.organization: Mother Mary of Hope House III

items.title: Nazareth House Holistic Housing I
items.summary: Transitional family housing with case management to help families address challenges, build skills, and prepare for independent living.

items.title: Nazareth House Holistic Housing II
items.summary: Transitional family housing with case management to help families address challenges, build skills, and prepare for independent living.

items.title: NeighborGood Partners: Wilmington
items.summary: Homeownership education, foreclosure prevention, DEHAP rental assistance, and one-on-one financial coaching to strengthen housing stability.

items.title: Neighborhood House
items.summary: Housing advice, rental and homebuying assistance, and homebuyer education workshops in English and Spanish. Two locations serving Wilmington.

items.title: Northeast State Service Center
items.summary: Emergency financial assistance for rent, utilities, and shelter for eligible low-income individuals facing an unforeseen crisis.

items.title: Oxford House - Browntown
items.summary: Self-run recovery house for men recovering from alcoholism or drug addiction. Residents share rent and expenses. Multiple Oxford House locations exist in Wilmington.

items.title: Oxford Houses of Delaware
items.summary: Self-run sober living homes for individuals in recovery. Residents share rent and expenses. Women with children are eligible.

items.title: Porter State Service Center
items.summary: Emergency financial assistance for rent, utilities, and shelter for eligible low-income individuals facing an unforeseen crisis.

items.title: Sacred Heart Village
items.summary: 77 affordable apartments for income-eligible seniors age 62 and older.

items.title: St. Francis Holistic Housing
items.summary: Up to two years of transitional family housing with a private unit and case management to address root causes of homelessness and build toward independent living.

items.title: STEHM - Martha House I & II
items.summary: Long-term transitional housing for women and their children with counseling and life skills training to prevent recurring homelessness.

items.title: STEHM - Motel Ministry
items.summary: Short-term emergency motel placement for displaced individuals. Referrals accepted from social service agencies, schools, and hospitals. One-week stay, once per calendar year.

items.title: Sunday Breakfast Mission
items.summary: Shelter for men experiencing homelessness and substance abuse, plus women and women with children. Clothing vouchers provided for the Urban Vintage thrift store.

items.title: West End Neighborhood House - Life Lines Program
items.summary: Comprehensive support for foster care and unaccompanied youth ages 16–23, including LGBTQ+ youth, covering housing, education, employment, mental health, and life skills.
items.organization: West End Neighborhood House - Life Lines Program

items.title: William Booth Emergency Housing Residence
items.summary: 90-day emergency shelter for women and children focused on preventing recurring homelessness through workshops and support groups.

items.title: Wilmington Housing Authority - Housing Choice Vouchers
items.summary: Federal housing vouchers helping eligible low-income residents pay rent in the community. Waitlist opens periodically — keep contact information current. WHA manages 1,976 vouchers.
items.organization: Wilmington Housing Authority - Housing Choice Vouchers

items.title: Wilmington Housing Authority - Public Housing Units
items.summary: Affordable public housing units for low-income residents including seniors and people with disabilities. Income must not exceed 80% of local median income. Apply directly through WHA.
items.organization: Wilmington Housing Authority - Public Housing Units

items.title: Wilmington Senior Center - Lafayette Court Apartments
items.summary: Affordable efficiency and one-bedroom apartments for residents age 55 and older, located next to the Wilmington Senior Center.
items.organization: Wilmington Senior Center - Lafayette Court Apartments

items.title: YWCA Delaware - SCHE Joint Transitional Housing and Rapid Re-housing
items.summary: Transitional and rapid re-housing for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking, and dating violence, with wraparound case management and financial assistance toward stable permanent housing.
items.organization: YWCA Delaware - SCHE Joint Transitional Housing and Rapid Re-housing
